chapterInfo.content:
103
Me kra, hyira AWURADE
Dawid deɛ.
1Me kra, hyira AWURADE,
na me mu adeɛ nyinaa nhyira ne din kronkron.
2Me kra, hyira AWURADE,
na mma wo werɛ mmfiri ne nneyɛɛ pa nyinaa.
3 # Dwom 32.1 Ɔno na ɔde wo mfomsoɔ nyinaa kyɛ woɔ,
na ɔsa wo nyarewa nyinaa.
4 # Dwom 5.12 Ɔgye wo nkwa firi Amena mu,
ɔde adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu bɔ wo abotire.
5 # Yes 40.31 Ɔde adepa hyɛ w’afono ma
na wo mmeranteberɛ yɛ foforɔ sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ.
6AWURADE di asɛntenenee,
na ɔbu atɛn gye wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn soɔ nyinaa.
7 # Eks 33.13 Ɔde n’akwan kyerɛɛ Mose,
ɔmaa Israel mma hunuu ne nneyɛɛ.
8 # Eks 34.6; Dwom 86.15 Mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ ne AWURADE,
ne bo kyɛre fu, na n’adɔeɛ dɔɔso.
9 # Yes 57.16 Ɔrenham nkɔsi daapem,
na ɔrennya yɛn menasepɔ nkɔsi daa.
10Ɔnsusu yɛn bɔne so ne yɛn nni,
na ɔnhwɛ yɛn mfomsoɔ nhyɛ yɛn ananmu.
11 # Dwom 33.6 Na sɛ ɔsoro ware sene asase no,
sɛ n’adɔeɛ so, wɔn a wɔsuro no soɔ ne no.
12Sɛ apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ ntam ware no,
sɛ wama yɛn ne yɛn mmarato ntam aware ne no.
13Sɛ agya yam hyehye no ne mma ho
no, sɛ AWURADE yam yɛ no wɔn a wɔsuro no ho ne no.
14 # Hiob 10.9; Gye 2.7; 3.19 Na ɔnim yɛn su,
ɔkae sɛ yɛyɛ mfuturo.
15 # Dwom 90.5-6; 1 Pe 1.24-25 Ɔdasani deɛ, ne nna te sɛ ɛserɛ,
ɔyɛ frɔmm sɛ wiram nhwiren.
16Sɛ mframa bɔ fa ne so a, na ɔnni hɔ,
na ne sibea nni no bio.
17 # Kwa 3.22; Luk 1.50 Na AWURADE adɔeɛ firi daa kɔ daa,
wɔn a wɔsuro no so,
na ne tenenee wɔ hɔ ma mma mma,
18ma wɔn a wɔdi n’apam soɔ,
na wɔkae n’ahyɛdeɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ.
19AWURADE de n’adwa asi soro,
na n’ahennie di ade nyinaa so.
20 # Dwom 29.1; Dan 7.10 AWURADE abɔfoɔ, monhyira no,
mo ahoɔden mu akatakyie a modi n’asɛm soɔ
na motie ne kasa no.
21AWURADE asafo nyinaa, monhyira no,
n’asomfo a moyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani no.
22 # Dwom 148 AWURADE nnwuma nyinaa, monhyira no,
mmeammea a ɔdi tumi nyinaa.
Me kra, hyira AWURADE.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me kra, hyira AWURADE,
na me mu adeɛ nyinaa nhyira ne din kronkron.
Me kra, hyira AWURADE,
na mma wo werɛ mmfiri ne nneyɛɛ pa nyinaa.
Ɔno na ɔde wo mfomsoɔ nyinaa kyɛ woɔ,
na ɔsa wo nyarewa nyinaa.
Ɔgye wo nkwa firi Amena mu,
ɔde adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu bɔ wo abotire.
Ɔde adepa hyɛ w’afono ma
na wo mmeranteberɛ yɛ foforɔ sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ.
AWURADE di asɛntenenee,
na ɔbu atɛn gye wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn soɔ nyinaa.
Ɔde n’akwan kyerɛɛ Mose,
ɔmaa Israel mma hunuu ne nneyɛɛ.
Mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ ne AWURADE,
ne bo kyɛre fu, na n’adɔeɛ dɔɔso.
Ɔrenham nkɔsi daapem,
na ɔrennya yɛn menasepɔ nkɔsi daa.
Ɔnsusu yɛn bɔne so ne yɛn nni,
na ɔnhwɛ yɛn mfomsoɔ nhyɛ yɛn ananmu.
Na sɛ ɔsoro ware sene asase no,
sɛ n’adɔeɛ so, wɔn a wɔsuro no soɔ ne no.
Sɛ apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ ntam ware no,
sɛ wama yɛn ne yɛn mmarato ntam aware ne no.
Sɛ agya yam hyehye no ne mma ho
no, sɛ AWURADE yam yɛ no wɔn a wɔsuro no ho ne no.
Na ɔnim yɛn su,
ɔkae sɛ yɛyɛ mfuturo.
Ɔdasani deɛ, ne nna te sɛ ɛserɛ,
ɔyɛ frɔmm sɛ wiram nhwiren.
Sɛ mframa bɔ fa ne so a, na ɔnni hɔ,
na ne sibea nni no bio.
Na AWURADE adɔeɛ firi daa kɔ daa,
wɔn a wɔsuro no so,
na ne tenenee wɔ hɔ ma mma mma,
ma wɔn a wɔdi n’apam soɔ,
na wɔkae n’ahyɛdeɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ.
AWURADE de n’adwa asi soro,
na n’ahennie di ade nyinaa so.
AWURADE abɔfoɔ, monhyira no,
mo ahoɔden mu akatakyie a modi n’asɛm soɔ
na motie ne kasa no.
AWURADE asafo nyinaa, monhyira no,
n’asomfo a moyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani no.
AWURADE nnwuma nyinaa, monhyira no,
mmeammea a ɔdi tumi nyinaa.
Me kra, hyira AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
